description: As the Co-founder of HackShastra, I play a key role in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of our initiatives. I lead cross-functional efforts to build a strong tech-driven community, organize impactful hackathons, and drive innovation through collaboration with developers, partners, and organizations.
achievements: Co-founded HackShastra and work on the technical side of the community and its platforms.
Built and maintained the HackShastra website using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Worked on hackathon websites, registration pages, participant dashboards, and event platforms.

description: Partnered with designers and founders to turn ambitious ideas into expressive, accessible web experiences.
